title: New restaurant in Mall World opened called “Brave New World”.
content: I wanted to share this because it would be really fascinating if anyone else has experienced this detail. Last night / this morning in Mall World I noticed a new restaurant had opened outside the mall itself and it looked kind of like an upmarket Parisian bistro with nice tables outside and it was quite busy. I looked at the sign and it was called “Brave New World”. And I thought hmm that’s an interesting name choice for a restaurant… I thought to myself I wonder if the general population will get the reference or will they just take it at face value. It’s not totally strange that I would dream a detail like this, as I recently listened to Huxley’s 1962 Berkeley lecture. But the thing about the dream that was striking was that it felt kind of lucid in a way. I was stepping back, thinking about my philosophical views in my real life, and in a way sort of realising that the Mall World was filled with “NPC’s”, (for no use of a better word). I was wondering if the people in Mall World think like I do, and questioning everything, or are they just going along with it mindlessly. So it’s a long shot, but if anyone else has dreamed this then wow, I would love to know.
